'''2007 Worlds Team Brian Hunter LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
